rule.statement: Forcing the authorities to recommence the acquisition process without resorting to obtain possession based on section 38(a) notice issued twenty years ago would cause serious obstruction and impede the progress of the project, which is already stalled over a long period of time.
rule.supporting_quote: forcing the authorities to recommence the acquisition process without resorting to obtain possession based on section 38(a) notice issued twenty years ago in my view would cause serious obstruction and impede the progress of the project, which is already stalled over a long period of time.
